name: Phishing leads to account takeover
story: A marketing user enters her password on a look-alike Microsoft login page. The attacker pushes MFA prompts until one is approved, signs in from Singapore 54 minutes after a Kansas City sign-in, and creates an inbox forwarding rule. The agent disables the account, revokes sessions, blocks the phishing URL, domain and attacker IP, and queues it: fully contained, no need to wake anyone.

incident.title: Suspicious sign-in after user clicked a phishing link
incident.description: Defender for Office 365 reported that the user clicked a URL later identified as phishing. Entra ID Protection flagged an unfamiliar sign-in shortly after.
incident.product: Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Entra ID Protection
